items.name: Morvah's Shawl
items.lore: Folded neatly, as if for a stranger. It smells of salt and summer evenings.

items.name: Drowned-Net Belt
items.lore: Knotted from a net that has been mended every evening for a thousand years.

items.name: Salt-Pearl Ring
items.lore: A pearl from the drowned land. It is always wet.

items.name: Evening Star Pendant
items.lore: Silver, set with a pale stone that glows at dusk.

items.name: Reliquary Shard
items.lore: A shard of black glass from an Arawnite reliquary. Something moves inside it.

items.name: Kendric's Watch-Cloak
items.lore: A knight's travelling cloak, salt-stained from the Lyonesse wind.

items.name: Drowned Knight Signet
items.lore: The ring of a knight of Lyonesse. He drowned with his king.

items.name: Tobin's Bracer
items.lore: A squire's bracer. Tobin insisted.

items.name: Hierophant's Girdle
items.lore: Bone and black silk, taken from a priest of Arawn. Scrubbed, and blessed, and still not quite clean.

items.name: Peallaidh-Scale Bracer
items.lore: Sea-green scales, sharp at the edges.

items.name: Remnant Picket Ring
items.lore: Salt-stained iron. The Remnant's own.

items.name: Bone-Snapper Jaw Charm
items.lore: A jaw-bone, wired shut. Still twitches.

items.name: Drowned-Field Belt
items.lore: Mud-black leather.

items.name: Moorlich-Bog Ring
items.lore: Black bog-iron, set with a drowned man's tooth.

items.name: Mire-Walker's Mantle
items.lore: Oiled and black. Mire doesn't stick to it.

items.name: Tristan's Harp-Peg
items.lore: A harp-peg of black yew, worn smooth by a master's hand.

items.name: Goblin-Hoard Ring
items.lore: From the pygmy goblins' hoard. They had good taste.

items.name: Harper's Travelling Cloak
items.lore: Blue and gold, Lyonesse's colours.

items.name: Black-Sail Ring
items.lore: Black and white enamel, half and half.

items.name: Isolde's Pearl
items.lore: A sea-pearl, found in the wreck.

items.name: Wreck-Diver's Belt
items.lore: Weighted, so you sink when you want to.

items.name: Hamadryad Leaf-Crown
items.lore: A crown of green leaves that never wither.

items.name: Heartwood Bracer
items.lore: Dark heartwood, carved with a tree.

items.name: Gabriel-Hound Collar
items.lore: Black iron, with a ring for a chain no one ever held.

items.name: Hound-Ward Charm
items.lore: A twist of rowan and iron, against the hounds of the sky.

items.name: Witherwoode Splinter
items.lore: Grey wood. It's colder than ice.

items.name: Wither-Bark Mantle
items.lore: Bark-grey, stiff, warm on the inside.

items.name: Storm-Glass Ring
items.lore: A ring of fused sand from a lightning-strike.

items.name: Drowned-Farm Shawl
items.lore: Homespun, sea-stained. A drowned farmer's wife made it.

items.name: Storm-Caller's Lightning-Rod
items.lore: A twisted iron rod. Your hair stands up when you hold it.

items.name: Weatherproof Mantle
items.lore: Tarred wool. Nothing gets through.

items.name: Claw-Mark Bracer
items.lore: Scored with a dragon's claw, deliberately.

items.name: Stormheart Charm
items.lore: The heart of the storm-engine, cracked and quiet.

items.name: Calm-Sea Ring
items.lore: Blue glass. The sea is calm in it.

items.name: Remnant Captain's Mantle
items.lore: Lyonesse blue, salt-white at the hem.

items.name: Pikeman's Gorget
items.lore: Drowned steel, scoured clean.

items.name: Drowned Pike-Ring
items.lore: From a pike's butt-cap.

items.name: Drowned Knight's Spur
items.lore: Silver, green with age.

items.name: Lyonesse Shield-Strap
items.lore: From a knight's shield. Blue and gold, faded.

items.name: Knight's Vigil Ring
items.lore: A plain ring, engraved: 'Until the sea goes back.'

items.name: Meliodas's Crown-Ring
items.lore: A drowned king's crown, cut into a ring. Seawater drips from it.

items.name: Lyonesse Royal Mantle
items.lore: Blue, with Lyonesse's sun in gold.

items.name: Father's Sorrow Torc
items.lore: Meliodas wore it for Tristan.

items.name: Tide-Lord's Charm
items.lore: A shell that hums with the tide.

items.name: Cailleach's Staff-Head
items.lore: A stone the size of a fist, worn into a face.

items.name: Sea-Wind Mantle
items.lore: Grey as a winter sea. The wind can't touch whoever wears it.

items.name: Keeper of Tristan's Lay Ring
items.lore: A harp in gold, very small.

items.name: Hag-Stone Torc
items.lore: A holed stone. Look through it and you see true.
